title: Check whether a key exists
summary: EXISTS checks for a key without reading its value.
introduction: EXISTS checks for a key without reading its value. Your task: Explain why the last existence check is zero.
learningObjectives: Explain why the last existence check is zero.
Explain the example for check whether a key exists

blocks.text: EXISTS checks for a key without reading its value. DEL removes the named key.
Use a local Redis server and redis-cli. Commands here use cma: practice keys only. Redis commands do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Do not connect these exercises to a production database.

blocks.code:
SET cma:temporary "sample"
EXISTS cma:temporary
DEL cma:temporary
EXISTS cma:temporary
blocks.title: Check whether a key exists

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: EXISTS returns a count of named keys that are present.
DEL removes only the supplied key, so the second existence check returns zero.

blocks.text: The first existence check returns 1, and the final check returns 0.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Delete only the intended practice key. Broad cleanup commands can remove unrelated data.
